title: Fixed subdirectory homepage links with query strings
summary: Architecture: Admin stores navigation links relative to the site base, and the public site adds the base path when rendering. Problem: a homepage URL missing its trailing slash before a query or fragment keeps the base path, so rendering adds that path twice. Solution: normalize the matching homepage path to a slash and retain its query and fragment. For a site at /blog/, save /?ref=menu instead of /blog?ref=menu.
validation: Proposed formatter fix. Verify homepage query, fragment, combined variants and child-path controls. No UI visual redesign.
